about: The icon packages this plugin knows: public packages that ship icons as components or modules, by the name code imports them from. A module under a package (name/path) is that package. Once a repository has a row of the kind icon-set in its sources ledger, the gate turns red when code imports a package of this list that no such row records. Data a person may edit: a package added here reaches a repository when the check of the icons used is laid there. It names public libraries, never a user's brand.
